name: Root
tooltip: How loud Root, the warm foundation with its sub octave, sits in the mix.

name: Clearing
tooltip: How loud Clearing, the analog saw ensemble, sits in the mix.

name: Expanse
tooltip: How loud Expanse, the airy choir with its shimmer, sits in the mix.

name: Bloom
tooltip: How loud Bloom, the moving pad with filter sweep and tremolo, sits in the mix.

name: Attack
tooltip: How quickly notes fade in; shows Root's time, Bloom is about half as long.
notes: display hand-written: Root's time (dsp/EnvelopeMacro.h); paramgen has no display column yet; read at note-on

name: Release
meaning: 24 ms / 0.24 s / 2.4 s before the room
tooltip: How long notes fade out after release; shows Root's time before the reverb.
notes: display hand-written: Root's time (dsp/EnvelopeMacro.h); paramgen has no display column yet; read at note-on

name: Filter
meaning: half the designed cutoff / designed / double
tooltip: Overall brightness of every layer, darker to the left, brighter to the right.

name: Reverb
meaning: dry / half send / full wet tail
tooltip: How much of the shared reverb is mixed in, from dry to a full wet tail.

name: Width
meaning: mono / Root still narrow / full spread
tooltip: Stereo width; the airy pads open first, Root last, and the bass stays centred.

name: Detune
meaning: half the designed detune / designed / double
tooltip: How far each pad's stacked oscillators drift apart; the middle is the designed sound.
notes: eased out below C3; default 0 by the owner's blind A/B 2026-10-06
